scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env REPLAY_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env ../../node_modules/electron/cli.js ."
